# Regenerating Autogenerated Files

The `.autogenerated/` directories in this example contain generated Docker configurations that need to be kept in sync with the source `service.json` files.

## When to Regenerate

After cloning this repository or updating the `tdk-cli-core` version, regenerate the autogenerated files by running:

```bash
tdk up
```

This will:
- Regenerate all `Dockerfile.app.autogenerated` files
- Update all `tsconfig.docker.autogenerated.json` configurations
- Regenerate Tilt resource manifests
- Ensure TypeScript types align with your Bun/Node setup

## What Gets Generated

The generator creates:
- `services/**/*/autogenerated/Dockerfile.app.autogenerated` - Multi-stage Docker build configuration
- `services/**/*/autogenerated/tsconfig.docker.autogenerated.json` - TypeScript config for Docker builds
- `services/**/*/autogenerated/*.autogenerated.json` - Various configuration files

## Why This Matters

Stale generated files can cause:
- TypeScript compilation errors (`TS2688: Cannot find type definition file`)
- Incorrect Docker layer caching
- Incompatibility with the current CLI version

Always commit the regenerated files to git so other developers don't need to run `tdk up` immediately after cloning.
